As a Plastic Welder, you will be responsible for joining different components to create finished products using various welding techniques. You will work carefully according to work orders and technical instructions.

Your tasks include:

- Welding and assembling components using different welding techniques
- Working according to work orders, technical drawings and specified tolerances
- Ensuring the quality of the welding and finished products
- Performing quality checks and following the required control procedures
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process
- Suggesting improvements to product quality and production processes
- Following safety instructions and using personal protective equipment (PPE) when required

You will work in a day-shift schedule with the following working hours:

- Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 16:00 in Witbogt.

- Minimum B2 level of English or B2–C1 level of Dutch.
- MBO-level thinking and working ability.
- Experience with plastic welding is required.
- Knowledge of different plastic welding techniques, such as tacking, extrusion, and/or wire welding.
- Ability to read work orders, technical drawings, and work instructions.
- Technical insight and attention to tolerances and quality standards.
- Accurate, precise, and quality-focused way of working.
- Responsible and proactive attitude.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Flexible and stress-resistant approach to work.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Willingness to follow production and safety procedures and use PPE when required.

What do we do? The work of our department is very diverse, everyday is different. Within your role as a Front Desk Agent, your responsibilities include the safety and experience of our hotel guests. The work includes: 
• Welcoming, checking in and checking out our hotel guests
• Optimising the guest experience and ensuring they have an unforgettable time
• Dealing with and resolving hotel guests' challenges and inconveniences
• Various administrative duties 
• F&B work
• Keeping guests informed of fun events in the area

Who are we looking for? We are looking for an enthusiastic colleague with the following skills and attributes: 
• You have good communication skills in Dutch and English
• You have experience with a hotel reservation system, preferably MEWS 
• You have previous working experience in a hotel 
• You have a hospitable attitude 
• You are flexible and enjoy working different shifts, including weekends and holidays 
• You are independent 
What can you expect from us?
• A competitive salary
• Flexible working hours
• Opportunities for continuous self-development through internal and external training opportunities
• A young and dynamic team where everyone finds it important to have fun at work 
• To feed your ambition, you can work on your personal development and grow with us
• We celebrate your birthday with a present 
At Amsterdam Lake Hotel, we create a dynamic workplace where no day is the same. You experience a lot and there is always room for innovation and your own input. We are always looking for people who think along with us. We also give our employees the opportunity to develop themselves further within the hotel industry. Your enthusiasm and drive determine which steps you take.

Are you looking for a hands-on role where you can immediately see the results of your work? Do you enjoy working with precision and want to be part of an international high-tech company? Then this opportunity could be the perfect fit for you.

What are you going to do?
As a Packing Operator, you play a key role in ensuring high-quality precision products reach customers around the world safely and in perfect condition. Your responsibilities include:

- Reviewing and processing work instructions
- Selecting the correct packaging materials
- Creating custom-sized boxes when required
- Performing quality checks on products
- Carefully packaging precision components
- Verifying and registering quantities
- Keeping your workspace clean, organized, and safe

What do we offer?
- Gross hourly wage of €16.77
- Full-time position in a day shift schedule
- 27 vacation days per year
- Opportunity for a permanent contract
- A stable, innovative, and international working environment
- A supportive team culture focused on quality and collaboration

Where will you work?
Our client is a leading specialist in aluminium precision products. From their facility in Venlo, they manufacture high-quality components for customers in the high-tech, medical, and automotive industries. Innovation, craftsmanship, and quality are at the heart of everything they do.

What do we ask?
- Strong attention to detail and quality
- Good Dutch, German or English language skills, both written and spoken
- Experience in logistics, production, or packaging is an advantage
- The ability to work independently and take ownership
- A practical mindset and flexible attitude

Are you interested?
Apply today or contact Mette or July at +31 (0)77 382 89 46.
